entities.name: Safehold
entities.description: An elven refuge and stronghold found in Shadowmoor, fortified with walls.

entities.name: Shadowmoor
entities.description: The plane where the safeholds stand, in which elves huddle behind fortified walls.

entities.name: Lorwyn
entities.description: The plane where elves are free-roaming throughout the Gilt-Leaf Wood.

entities.name: Gilt-Leaf Wood
entities.description: The wood in Lorwyn where elves roam freely.

entities.name: Wilt-Leaf Wood
entities.description: A wood in Shadowmoor; safeholds lie both inside and outside it.

entities.name: Cayr Ulios
entities.description: The capital, largest and most centrally located safehold of the Wilt-Leaf Wood.

entities.name: Dusklight Safehold
entities.description: A safehold attacked by merrow and later destroyed by an army of creatures from the Wilt-Leaf Wood.

entities.name: Cloudbreaker
entities.description: A magical stone that, according to myth, could summon a powerful creature to act as a defender.

entities.name: Cavan
entities.description: An elf of Dusklight and the only survivor of its destruction after killing two fellow elves.

entities.name: Lochran Safehold
entities.description: The safehold where Valya and her family lived.

entities.name: Valya
entities.description: An elf of Lochran Safehold whose parents were killed at Trendan's Safehold, leaving her with only her grandmother.

entities.name: Safehold Taldwen
entities.description: The safehold of the legendary hero Gond.

entities.name: Gond
entities.description: A legendary hero whose home was Safehold Taldwen.

entities.name: Strongroot Safehold
entities.description: The only safehold in Raven's Run, destroyed by treefolk led by Amur Brokenlimb.

entities.name: Raven's Run
entities.description: A region of Shadowmoor containing Strongroot Safehold.

entities.name: Amur Brokenlimb
entities.description: A Canker witch who led treefolk to destroy Strongroot Safehold.

entities.name: Joram Twohorns
entities.description: The only survivor of Strongroot Safehold and unwitting pawn of Amur's schemes.

entities.name: Trendan's Safehold
entities.description: A safehold that fell to a boggart horde.

entities.name: Trendan
entities.description: Leader of Trendan's Safehold who called for aid from other safeholds.

events.summary: The elves of Dusklight find the Cloudbreaker after suffering attacks from nearby merrow, then kill the merrow with a strong poison.
events.quote: After the elves killed off the merrow with a strong poison

events.summary: An army of creatures from the Wilt-Leaf Wood attacks Dusklight Safehold; the elves refuse to use the Cloudbreaker and the safehold is destroyed, with Cavan the only survivor.
events.quote: The elves did not use the Cloudbreaker, feeling they were unworthy of it, and the safehold was destroyed.

events.summary: Valya's parents leave Lochran Safehold to defend Trendan's Safehold, where they are killed.
events.quote: After her parents left to defend Trendan's Safehold, where they were killed

events.summary: Treefolk led by Amur Brokenlimb destroy Strongroot Safehold; Joram Twohorns is the only survivor.
events.quote: Joram Twohorns was the only survivor and unwitting pawn of Amur's schemes.

events.summary: A banshee riles up boggarts, Trendan calls for aid, and Trendan's Safehold falls to the boggart horde despite reinforcements.
events.quote: the safehold fell to the boggart horde

relations.note: Capital safehold of the Wilt-Leaf Wood.
relations.quote: the capital and and largest and most centrally located safehold of the Wilt-Leaf Wood

relations.note: Valya lived there with her family.
relations.quote: the safehold where Valya and her family lived
